title: Code Review Simulator: Work on Cityscapes
body:
Working on cityscapes for Code Review Simulator.

Trying out a few different layouts, from compact city blocks and riverside streets to harbors, farms, and small villages.

![Eleven stylized 3D environments for Code Review Simulator, showing city blocks, a riverside, farmland, a forest outpost, a harbor, a roadside stop, and alpine, lakeside, and orchard villages.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-work-on-cityscapes/cityscapes-contact-sheet.png)
